craft_notes: Sthāyin: crumbs. Sanskrit-first: diminishing series kept. Rows: 2. Close: unclaimed. Rejected: inventing the last holder — killed: unexpressed stays so. Read aloud: thinning cadence.

lines: Crumbs for kings, and one crumb left to find.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pādaṃ ca vāmanādibhyaḥ pādārdhaṃ bhārgavāya ca | pādapādaṃ tu balaye pādapādastu yo@paraḥ
